chunks: And Mu'awiyyah ibn Maythara asked him

about a man who is traveling and does not find water, so he performs tayammum and prays. Then he finds water while there is still some time remaining. Should he continue with his prayer or perform wudu and repeat the prayer? He said: 'He should continue with his prayer, for the Lord of the water is the Lord of the earth.'
ai.seo_question: Does a traveler need to repeat their prayer if they find water after performing tayammum but before the prayer time ends?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih*, Imam al-Sadiq (as) establishes that finding water after performing tayammum does not invalidate the prayer, provided the time has not fully expired. This ruling underscores the principle of *istishab* (presumption of continuity) and highlights the theological equivalence of water and earth as purifying agents, affirming that the ritual act was valid at the time it was performed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.221 - Mu'awiyah ibn Maythara asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who is traveling, does not find water, performs tayammum, and prays. Then he finds water while there is still some time left (for the prayer). Should he continue with his prayer or perform wudu and repeat the prayer?
Imam (as) said: 'He should continue with his prayer, for the Lord (azj) of the water is the Lord (azj) of the earth.'
